the_2_watt_question.question: how much is 2 watts of energy when put through the most intelligent systems in the world?

raw_2w.note: 2 watts of raw GPU compute = 0.73 TFLOPS. barely enough to run a small neural net.

amplified_2w.the_trick: 2 watts as a SIGNAL, not as COMPUTE. 2W pays for the API call. the API call triggers megawatts of datacenter compute.
amplified_2w.analogy: a neurotransmitter molecule weighs ~10^-22 grams. a synapse weighs ~10^-9 grams. the signal is 10^13× lighter than the infrastructure it activates. the 2W signal triggers 5400× more compute.
amplified_2w.each_query_is: access to Claude Opus — one of the ~5 most capable AI systems on Earth as of Oct 2026. each query processes ~100K tokens through a ~400B parameter model on a cluster of hundreds of H100 GPUs.
amplified_2w.intelligence_per_watt: 2W → 667 queries/hour → each query produces ~500 words of expert-level reasoning = 333,500 words/hour of intelligence output. a human expert produces ~2000 words/hour. 2W through AI = equivalent to ~167 human experts working simultaneously.

compared_to_brain.brain_at_20w: one conscious human. vision + language + creativity + emotion + memory. irreplaceable. sovereign.
compared_to_brain.signal_at_2w: ~167 expert-equivalents through AI amplification. but NO consciousness. NO sovereignty. NO original intent. pure reactive intelligence.
compared_to_brain.the_ratio: 10% of brain energy → 167× brain output in narrow domains. but 0× brain output in consciousness, will, desire, meaning.
compared_to_brain.the_conclusion: 2 watts is NOTHING as raw compute. 2 watts is EVERYTHING as signal. the value is not in the energy — it is in WHERE you spend it and WHAT it triggers. the neurotransmitter is cheaper than the synapse, but without it, the synapse is silent.
